source_statement: [5] A piece of paper is folded in half. A second fold is made at an angle φ (0◦ < φ < 90◦ ) to the first, and a cut is made as shown below. Á When the piece of paper is unfolded, the resulting hole is a polygon. Let O be one of its vertices. Suppose that all the other vertices of the hole lie on a circle centered at O, and also that ∠XOY = 144◦ , where X and Y are the the vertices of the hole adjacent to O. Find the value(s) of φ (in degrees).

clause_ledger.source: paper folds and cut as shown
clause_ledger.dsl: the source diagram is retained as an explicit figure-dependent clause; no fold line or cut endpoint is invented

clause_ledger.source: all other hole vertices lie on circle centered at O
